invitation_open_company_email_idx.name: invitation_open_company_email_idx
invitation_open_company_email_idx.where: "invitation"."company_id" is not null and "invitation"."accepted_at" is null and "invitation"."revoked_at" is null

invitation_open_staff_email_idx.name: invitation_open_staff_email_idx
invitation_open_staff_email_idx.where: "invitation"."company_id" is null and "invitation"."accepted_at" is null and "invitation"."revoked_at" is null

request_attachment_entry_fits.name: request_attachment_entry_fits
request_attachment_entry_fits.value: "request_attachment"."entry_id" is null or "request_attachment"."request_id" is not null

request_attachment_sent_fits.name: request_attachment_sent_fits
request_attachment_sent_fits.value: ("request_attachment"."request_id" is null or "request_attachment"."uploaded_at" is not null) and ("request_attachment"."removed_at" is null or "request_attachment"."request_id" is not null)

request_attachment_removed_fits.name: request_attachment_removed_fits
request_attachment_removed_fits.value: "request_attachment"."removed_at" is not null or ("request_attachment"."removed_by" is null and not "request_attachment"."removed_signed_in_as" and "request_attachment"."file_deleted_at" is null)

request_entry_kind_fits_values.name: request_entry_kind_fits_values
request_entry_kind_fits_values.value: ("request_entry"."kind" in ('comment', 'note')) = ("request_entry"."body" is not null) and ("request_entry"."kind" in ('comment', 'note')) = ("request_entry"."to_value" is null)

request_entry_assignment_fits_values.name: request_entry_assignment_fits_values
request_entry_assignment_fits_values.value: case when "request_entry"."kind" = 'assignee' then "request_entry"."to_value" in ('assigned', 'unassigned') else "request_entry"."subject_user_id" is null end
